title: Tonbankcard Testnet Deployment Manifest (B1)
description: Canonical layout for `deployments/testnet/<timestamp>.json` files written by `scripts/deploy/deploy.ts` during engagement B1. Phase 2 and Phase 4 each produce a separate manifest with this schema; Phase 4 carries `environment = "testnet-only"`. The manifest is the source of truth referenced by `STATUS.md` §7/§8, `docs/existing-contracts.md`, and `docs/deployments/network-matrix.md`.

version.description: Schema version; bump only via a new B1 cycle.

manifestType.description: Static type tag used by `verify.ts` to reject foreign files.

network.description: B1 manifests target TON testnet only. The mainnet schema is governed by B2.

environment.description: Set to `testnet-only` for Phase 4 manifests so they are rejected by mainnet tooling.

phase.description: Engagement phase, mirrored to the contract subset deployed in this manifest.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the manifest was finalised; matches the filename.

commit.description: Full git SHA of the deploy commit; must equal `audit/FREEZE_METADATA.md` `freezeCommit`.

tact.description: Tact compiler version exactly as reported by `npx tact --version` on the deploy machine.

func.description: FunC compiler version exactly as reported by `func -V` on the deploy machine.

blueprint.description: @ton/blueprint version pinned in `package.json` at the deploy commit.

compilers.description: Toolchain versions used for the build; verified against `audit/FREEZE_METADATA.md`.

multiSigAddress.description: Testnet multi-sig address that signed every deploy transaction in this manifest.

threshold.description: Multi-sig threshold; single-key deployment is forbidden by NFR-4.

mainnetKeyReuse.description: Must be `false`. `verify.ts` aborts if any signer overlaps with a known mainnet signer.

deployer.description: Deployer multi-sig — its signers must be distinct from any mainnet signer.

adminAddress.description: Value of `ADMIN_ADDRESS` env var at deploy time. Bound to parameter-only authority (no fund control) by I3.

riskAuthority.description: Value of `RISK_AUTHORITY_ADDRESS` env var at deploy time. Must NOT equal `adminAddress`.

lendingAdapter.description: `null` until `LendingProtocolCoordinator` is wired (Phase 4). When set, points at the CoinRabbit-testnet adapter.

deploymentOrder.description: Names of the contracts deployed, in the deterministic order produced by `DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md` §3 (Phase 2) or §4 (Phase 4).

codeHash.description: SHA-256 of the deployed contract code cell; must equal the value in `DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md` §7.

deployBlock.description: Masterchain seqno at which the deploy transaction landed.

deployedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the deploy transaction (immutable across re-runs by idempotency).

initParameters.description: Map of init-parameter name → value, mirroring `DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md` §3.1 / §4.1.

status.description: Result of the `verify.ts` run for this contract.

report.description: Relative path to the verification report (`<manifest>.verification.json`).

testingOnly.description: Set `true` for every Phase 4 entry. Phase 2 entries either omit this field or set it to `false`.

notes.description: Free-form notes — typically invariant references (I1–I7) or trust assumptions.

contracts.description: Per-contract deployment records. Keys are the canonical contract names from `DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md`.

dryRun.description: `true` if produced by `--dry-run`; such manifests are never committed.

paused.description: `true` if `RUNBOOK.md` §8 (roll-back) has paused this manifest. Append-only — paused manifests stay in the audit trail; corrections add new manifests.

supersedes.description: Filename of the prior manifest this one supersedes, or `null` for the first manifest of a phase.

supersededBy.description: Filename of the follow-up manifest that supersedes this one. `null` while this manifest is current.

AccountLocks.notes: Invariant I3 — admin cannot move funds; only set/clear locks.
